lessons: Reuse cached source evidence before searching.
Exclude already attempted Amazon books to avoid repeating unproductive searches. This round excluded 854 previously attempted book IDs.
Use title and author queries, Mistral Nemo, Parallel fast, and ten results per call. One-token output is sufficient only when source annotations are the intended output.
Match useful secondary results to their actual works; do not accept counts for related books as the queried book.
Twenty reference searches supplied no accepted counts; do not infer counts from reference-section presence.
Keep the separate Mistral Small 24B audit and resolve flags against source evidence.
This is a batch comparison, not a controlled causal test: field mix, cache availability and search difficulty differ.
scope: Recorded successful OpenRouter responses including all research and audits; not an invoice.
confidence: High for recorded costs and arithmetic; moderate for generalizing search efficiency.
